meta.file_purpose: FPS Overlay 简体中文语言对照文件。此文件用于软件开发者在不改动英文版的前提下，据此将 FPS Overlay 本地化为简体中文。
meta.file_purpose_en: Simplified Chinese localization reference for FPS Overlay. Software developers use this file to produce a Simplified Chinese build of the application.

developer_notes: 1. Usage: the JSON keys are the exact English string literals found in src/main.cpp. To localize, replace each literal with its 'zh-CN' value and recompile.
2. Printf format specifiers (%.0f, %d, %s, %f, %u, %d%%, %-12s) MUST be kept exactly in the translation and keep their relative order. '%d%%' renders a literal percent sign.

3. ImGui IDs: labels ending with '##...' (e.g. 'Change##1', 'Cancel##1', 'Change##2', 'Cancel##2') use '##' as an ImGui unique-ID separator. The '##...' suffix must be preserved unchanged; only the visible text before it is translated.
4. Whitespace: some labels begin with two leading spaces (e.g. '  FPS Counter (game)') or end with trailing spaces (e.g. 'Press any key...  ') for ImGui alignment. Preserve this whitespace exactly.

5. Newlines: '
' in dialog bodies must be preserved as literal '
' in the translation.
6. Unicode characters used by the original text: '→' (U+2192), '—' em dash (U+2014), '…' ellipsis (U+2026), '°' degree sign (U+00B0).

7. FONT REQUIREMENT (critical): the app currently loads the Latin-only font 'C:\Windows\Fonts\segoeui.ttf' and builds only the default glyph ranges + ™ © ® (see WinMain, src/main.cpp). To display Simplified Chinese, the developer MUST load a CJK font such as 'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc' (Microsoft YaHei) or 'simhei.ttf' and add the proper glyph ranges (e.g. ImFontGlyphRangesBuilder with a Chinese range set, or AddFontFromFileTTF with GlyphRangesChineseFull). Otherwise every Chinese character renders as a box (tofu).
8. Brand name: 'FPS Overlay' is the product name and should stay unchanged in all strings.
9. Version string 'v1.8.0' must not be translated.

10. Abbreviations FPS / CPU / GPU / RAM / VRAM / GB / W / MHz / RPM / N/A are widely recognized in Chinese software and are usually kept as-is. The translations below keep these abbreviations and translate only the surrounding descriptive words. For compact overlay labels, keeping the abbreviations is recommended.
11. AM/PM: FormatOverlayTime() outputs 'AM'/'PM' for 12-hour format (src/main.cpp). If a fully localized clock is desired, '上午'/'下午' may be substituted.
12. Temperature units: the '°C'/'°F' suffixes are generated by code ('%.0f°%s' with 'C'/'F'), not by static strings, and need no translation.
13. 'N/A' and '---' are data placeholders shown when a sensor has no value; translations below map 'N/A' to '无数据'. Developers may keep 'N/A'/'---' verbatim to match other FPS overlays.

14. Dialog entries in 'translations.dialogs' are structured objects (title_en/title_zh-CN/body_en/body_zh-CN) because the same short title like 'FPS Overlay' is reused by many dialogs and would collide as a JSON key in a flat map.
15. config.ini keys (Display/Layout/Hotkeys/GPU/Frequency sections) are internal identifiers, not user-facing text, and must not be translated or renamed.

dialogs.body_en:
Welcome to FPS Overlay!

For the best experience, it is recommended to disable other FPS overlays:

  - Steam Overlay (Steam > Settings > In-Game)
  - Xbox Game Bar (Windows Settings > Gaming)
  - NVIDIA GeForce Experience Overlay/NVIDIA ShadowPlay/NVIDIA App
  - AMD Radeon Software Overlay
  - Discord Overlay

This prevents conflicts and ensures accurate FPS readings.

Enjoy!
dialogs.body_zh-CN:
欢迎使用 FPS Overlay！

为了获得最佳体验，建议禁用其他 FPS 悬浮层：

  - Steam 悬浮层（Steam > 设置 > 游戏中）
  - Xbox 游戏栏（Windows 设置 > 游戏）
  - NVIDIA GeForce Experience 悬浮层 / NVIDIA ShadowPlay / NVIDIA App
  - AMD Radeon 软件悬浮层
  - Discord 悬浮层

这样可以避免冲突并确保 FPS 读数准确。

祝您游玩愉快！

dialogs.body_en:
The PawnIO driver is required for FPS Overlay.

LibreHardwareMonitor uses it for CPU and GPU temperatures. The app cannot continue without it.

Click OK to install PawnIO.
Click Cancel to exit.
dialogs.body_zh-CN:
FPS Overlay 需要 PawnIO 驱动程序。

LibreHardwareMonitor 使用它获取 CPU 和 GPU 温度。没有它，应用程序将无法继续运行。

点击“确定”安装 PawnIO。
点击“取消”退出。

dialogs.body_en:
PawnIO setup did not finish successfully. The installer exited with an error (for example, an existing PawnIO build must be removed first).

Uninstall PawnIO from Windows Settings → Apps → Installed apps, then click OK again here.
dialogs.body_zh-CN:
PawnIO 安装未能成功完成。安装程序以错误退出（例如，可能必须先移除现有的 PawnIO 版本）。

请从“Windows 设置 → 应用 → 已安装的应用”卸载 PawnIO，然后在此处再次点击“确定”。

dialogs.body_en: FPS Overlay could not save the restart requirement (config.ini or fpsoverlay-pawnio-reboot.state next to overlay.exe). Check the folder is writable, then try installing PawnIO again.
dialogs.body_zh-CN: FPS Overlay 无法保存重启要求（overlay.exe 旁边的 config.ini 或 fpsoverlay-pawnio-reboot.state）。请检查文件夹是否可写，然后重试安装 PawnIO。

dialogs.title_zh-CN: FPS Overlay — 需要更新 PawnIO
dialogs.body_en:
Your PawnIO driver is older than the version bundled with FPS Overlay.

An outdated PawnIO can break LibreHardwareMonitor (missing or wrong temperatures). You must update to continue.

Click OK to update now (replaces the existing install).
Click Cancel to exit.
dialogs.body_zh-CN:
您的 PawnIO 驱动程序版本低于 FPS Overlay 附带的版本。

过时的 PawnIO 可能会导致 LibreHardwareMonitor 出现问题（温度缺失或错误）。您必须更新后才能继续。

点击“确定”立即更新（将替换现有安装）。
点击“取消”退出。

dialogs.body_en:
PawnIO update did not finish successfully. The installer exited with an error (for example, the old version must be removed before installing again).

Uninstall PawnIO from Windows Settings → Apps → Installed apps, then click OK again here.
dialogs.body_zh-CN:
PawnIO 更新未能成功完成。安装程序以错误退出（例如，可能必须先移除旧版本才能再次安装）。

请从“Windows 设置 → 应用 → 已安装的应用”卸载 PawnIO，然后在此处再次点击“确定”。

dialogs.body_en: FPS Overlay could not save the restart requirement (config.ini or fpsoverlay-pawnio-reboot.state next to overlay.exe). Check the folder is writable, then try updating PawnIO again.
dialogs.body_zh-CN: FPS Overlay 无法保存重启要求（overlay.exe 旁边的 config.ini 或 fpsoverlay-pawnio-reboot.state）。请检查文件夹是否可写，然后重试更新 PawnIO。

dialogs.note: The body is built in code as: situation_lead + "\n\n" + body_template. The situation_lead strings are listed below as separate entries (restart_marker_invalid, cannot_verify_boot, must_restart_windows, pawnio_installed_success). The Yes/No choices map to the Windows MessageBox IDYES/IDNO buttons.
dialogs.body_en:
Important: save your work in other apps before restarting. Unsaved data may be lost.

A full system restart is required before FPS Overlay can run.

Yes — restart this PC now (FPS Overlay will close first)
No — restart later (FPS Overlay will close; use Start → Power → Restart when ready)
dialogs.body_zh-CN:
重要提示：重启前请保存其他应用中的工作，未保存的数据可能会丢失。

FPS Overlay 运行前需要完全重启系统。

是 —— 立即重启此电脑（FPS Overlay 将先关闭）
否 —— 稍后重启（FPS Overlay 将关闭；准备好后可通过“开始 → 电源 → 重启”重启）

dialogs.body_en:
FPS Overlay is waiting for a system restart after PawnIO was installed or updated, but the restart marker in config.ini is missing or invalid.

If this persists after restarting Windows, delete PawnIORequiresReboot and PawnIOInstallUtcHex under [App] in config.ini and delete fpsoverlay-pawnio-reboot.state next to overlay.exe.
dialogs.body_zh-CN:
FPS Overlay 正在等待 PawnIO 安装或更新后的系统重启，但 config.ini 中的重启标记缺失或无效。

如果重启 Windows 后问题仍然存在，请删除 config.ini 中 [App] 段下的 PawnIORequiresReboot 和 PawnIOInstallUtcHex，并删除 overlay.exe 旁边的 fpsoverlay-pawnio-reboot.state 文件。

dialogs.body_en: FPS Overlay cannot verify that this PC has restarted since PawnIO was installed or updated (Windows could not report the last boot time). A full restart is still required.
dialogs.body_zh-CN: FPS Overlay 无法确认此电脑在 PawnIO 安装或更新后已重启（Windows 无法提供上次启动时间）。仍然需要完全重启。

dialogs.body_en:
You must restart Windows before using FPS Overlay.

PawnIO was installed or updated earlier, and this session has not completed a full system restart yet.
dialogs.body_zh-CN:
在使用 FPS Overlay 之前，您必须重启 Windows。

PawnIO 已在之前安装或更新，而本次会话尚未完成完整的系统重启。

dialogs.body_en: PawnIO was installed or updated successfully.
dialogs.body_zh-CN: PawnIO 已成功安装或更新。

dialogs.body_en: Could not start an automatic restart. Please restart your PC manually (Start → Power → Restart), then start FPS Overlay again.
dialogs.body_zh-CN: 无法自动启动重启。请手动重启您的电脑（开始 → 电源 → 重启），然后再次启动 FPS Overlay。
